permissions: a short tap when a card is built or a drill step is completed
storage: Your plan, your guardians' names and the letter you write are stored in this app's private storage on this device. Your recovery phrase is never stored: it is held in memory only while cards are being built, and it is gone the moment you leave that screen.
extra: Keyfob never sees a blockchain address, a balance or a transaction, and it cannot move anything. It has no network permission, so it could not reach a chain even if it wanted to. It splits a phrase you already hold into guardian cards, and it writes down the plan for using them.

The phrase you type is turned into cards on the device and then discarded. Nothing about it is written to storage, to a log, or to any file the app produces. The cards themselves are yours to print or copy out; the app does not keep them either.
You will type the names of people you trust. Those names live on your device only. Tell them they are guardians, because a plan they have never heard of is not a plan.
